missable_warning.text: The only potentially missable trophy. One meditation happens only in Chapter 1 at Jason's house: after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. It is still unclear whether that meditation is required for the trophy, so do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. Every other trophy can be earned after the story in free-roam.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

stages.text: Play through the story and enjoy it. Do optional missions as they appear (purple icons, plus black icons with pink letters) — they introduce robberies, fishing, hunting and the other activities, and you need any 100 of them for the 100% checklist later. Along the way, scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study animals through your binoculars: 100% needs 200 of the 277 base vehicle models and 100 of the 255 animals, and studying is enough — you never have to hunt them. Do the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude (see the warning above) — it is the one thing that can pass you by.
stages.title: Story + optional missions — scan vehicles, study animals

stages.text: After the story, the checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is far more forgiving than it sounds — closer to 60% true completion. Most side quests are not required, and collectibles are only partly required. The tasks that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. You need any 70 of 80 challenges, so you can skip the hardest 10. Work through the checklist and A Long Road (gold) pops at the end; most of the grind trophies pop along the way.
stages.title: 100% Completion checklist + 70 of 80 challenges

stages.text: The Strangers & Freaks strands are not needed for 100%, so they are usually what is left afterwards — finish the 8 counting strands, then clean up whatever stray trophies remain (activities, hunts, the UFO easter egg). When the last one pops, the platinum follows.
stages.title: Strangers & Freaks + miscellaneous cleanup

tips: There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots) — 10 saves cover the 5 chapters, and you can rotate the other 5 in free-roam.
Cheats disable trophies and saving. They only unlock after the story, which is exactly when you will be mopping up most trophies — keep them off the platinum save.
Anything you do before the ending already counts toward the 100% checklist, even though the checklist itself only becomes visible after the story.
Quest givers sometimes go away for a while during the story (Kenton, for example), but every trophy-related character comes back and is still there in free-roam after the story.
title: Roadmap to the platinum
